description: Append one annotation to project context. Append-only: goals, activation events, glossary entries, and existing annotations stay in place. Allowed fields are project, occurred_at (ISO-8601 timestamp, stored as UTC), title (max 120 characters), and an optional note (max 500 characters). The annotation identity is normalized occurred_at plus title. A duplicate returns 200 with appended false and keeps the stored note. The 100 annotation cap returns 409 and stores nothing. Use this for a meaningful landing page, pricing, onboarding, feature, release, or experiment change. Do not store git commit logs, noisy edits, PII, secrets, or long notes.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the major product change happened

name: append_project_annotation
